requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map or Telegram bot. Reports undergo a lifecycle: Pending Approval -> Assigned (to technical offices) -> In Progress -> Resolved/Rejected/Suspended. The system supports external maintainers (with or without platform access), internal communication between staff and citizens, anonymous reporting, and detailed public/private statistics.

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to choose whether to make my report anonymous 
So that my name is not shown in the public list of reports.
constraints: Anonymous option protects privacy. Choice made at issue description time.
expected_behaviors: my name is not shown in the public list of reports

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a municipal administrator
I want to configure automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category
So that interventions will be faster.

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned' state and are sent to the competent technical office based on category.
Rejected reports require a mandatory explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Resolved status is set by the specific technical office staff member after intervention completion.
Suspended status indicates awaiting further evaluation or resources.
Internal comments between technical office and external maintainers are reserved (not visible to reporter/citizens).
Only authenticated users (citizens) can view reports initially; unregistered users can also view reports from Sprint 4 onwards.
An anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in the public map/list for citizens.
Once a report has been inserted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Public Relation officer can assign a report either to a specific technical office or directly to a staff member of that office.
External maintainers are added by the system administrator and must have their own individual account.
Automatic assignment logic for categories is left to teams but can be configured by administrators.
Notifications/messages can be set to real-time or on page refresh based on user preference.
Email is a mandatory field for registration and can be used for login.
Specific technical offices must be set up in the system documentation.
edge_cases: External maintainer with access (Case 1) resolves report directly; External maintainer without access (Case 2) requires technical office staff to resolve.
Zooming out on map groups reports into a cumulative view showing total count.
Downloading CSV while filters are active only exports the filtered subset.
Following a report stops when the report status becomes 'Resolved' or 'Rejected'.
Confirmation code for registration expires after 30 minutes.
Anonymous reports show 'anonymous' in public views but full name to staff.
assumptions: The system uses OpenStreetMap as the standard layer for geolocation.
Telegram bot integration requires users to provide a valid Telegram username in their profile.
Push notifications via Telegram are distinct from email and platform notifications.
The 'top 1%' and 'top 5%' statistics refer to reporters with the highest volume of reports.
External maintainers without access update status outside Participium, requiring manual status change by technical office staff.

setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member via POST /session.
Ensure a report exists in 'Pending Approval' state.

setup_needed: Authenticate as external maintainer via POST /session.

strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Configure automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category for faster interventions.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a stateful workflow test. Authenticate as a 'municipal administrator'. First, manually assign a specific report (ID: 12345) to a technical office via POST /reports/assign. Then, attempt to configure an automatic assignment rule for the same category that conflicts with the manual assignment or attempts to override it immediately. Verify how the system handles the interaction between existing manual assignments and new automatic rules (e.g., does it allow coexistence, reject the update, or require a reset?).
setup_needed: Manually assign a test report (e.g., ID: 12345) to a specific technical office via POST /reports/assign.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete the manually assigned report (ID: 12345) if it was created for this test, or verify its state is consistent with the automatic rule configuration.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the system's behavior when transitioning from manual assignment to automatic assignment logic, ensuring no data loss or unexpected state corruption occurs.
